correctness.rationale: The induced-map theorem reduces any deleted-square homotopy equivalence to f*(t^k)=t^(beta k)c. The exact program checks every permitted beta, every nonzero c in the 18-dimensional F_2 algebra, and all 19^2 Massey constraints for every target pair. The p=5 published formula controls, the p=19 homeomorphic control, and the p=7 and p=11 distinguishing controls pass.

value.rationale: The 2015 primary source explicitly asks whether deleted-square homotopy type distinguishes lens spaces up to homeomorphism. The order-19 case is a motivated finite classification: it covers all five homeomorphism classes and all 32 nonhomeomorphic normalized pairs, rather than adding a single isolated example. The result is an exact test of that question at a new prime, while leaving the global problem open.
